prompt: Our consultant says retention (A.1.4.8) and disposal (A.1.4.9) are new controls in ISO 27701:2025. True?
assertions: States retention maps from 2019's 7.4.7 and is not new
States disposal maps from 2019's 7.4.8 and is not new
Maps de-identification/deletion to 2019's 7.4.5 and PII transmission controls to 7.4.9 (controller) and 8.4.3 (processor)
Maps the subcontractor controls to 2019's 8.5.7 and 8.5.8
States the carry-over principle: the 2019 controls map across; the 2025 changes are structural (renumbering, standalone requirements, shared A.3 block)
